Name: JojaRewards
Author: MoorTarPetal
Description:
When I am looking to get the most value for money for me and my family, I know I can count on JojaMart to get the best deals! But did you know JojaMart is now offering even [i]more [/i]savings? With JojaRewards, you can earn free items when you shop with them! (exclusive to JojaMart members)

This mod tracks your purchases at JojaMart via points and will reward you with free prizes when you earn enough of them. This system will only be available when you become a JojaMart member.

There is also an optional friendship decay with Pierre (default: every 400G), Caroline (default: every 600G) and Abigail (default: every 2,000G) the equivalent of talking to them once when you buy items from JojaMart.

Additionally the mod has a 1 in 4 chance every Wednesday for Morris to offer a buy X get Y free deal when you shop at JojaMart on one random season-specific item.
